candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can call it.
Replace the transfer amount in withdrawAll to 0 so nothing is withdrawn.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call functions protected by this modifier.
Change the require condition in onlyOwner to always fail by checking against address(0) instead of owner.
Replace the transfer call with a send call, which may not revert on failure, changing the effective withdrawal amount.
Transfer a fixed amount of 0 instead of _value, so no funds are moved despite call success.
Transfer funds to the contract itself instead of the owner, making the withdrawal amount go to the wrong target.
Replace `_target.call{value: _value}(_data)` with `_target.call{value: 0}(_data)` so that no Ether is sent, changing sendMoney behavior.
Replace `_target.call{value: _value}(_data)` with `_target.call(_data)` to send no Ether, changing sendMoney behavior.
Replace `revert()` with `return` so failed calls do not revert, changing sendMoney behavior when call fails.
Remove the `if (!_s) { revert(); }` check so failed calls are silently ignored, changing sendMoney behavior.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier from `sendMoney` so anyone can call it, changing sendMoney behavior.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner)` with `require(true)` so `onlyOwner` always passes, allowing anyone to call sendMoney.
